subject: math
question: 若向量组 $\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \cdots, \alpha_{s}$ 线性无关， $\beta$ 可由 $\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \cdots, \alpha_{s}$ 线性表示，且表示式的系数全不为 0，则证明 $\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \cdots, \alpha_{s}, \beta$ 中任意 s 个向量线性无关.
answer: 任意 $s$ 个向量线性无关.

steps.text: 分析 由于 $\beta$ 可由 $\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\cdots,\alpha_{s}$ 线性表示，所以 $\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\cdots,\alpha_{s},\beta$ 中任意 s 个向量的线性关系均表现为 $\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\cdots,\alpha_{s}$ 的线性关系，因而是线性无关的.

反证法. 设 $\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \cdots, \alpha_{s}, \beta$ 中有 s 个向量 $\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \cdots, \alpha_{i-1}, \alpha_{i+1}, \cdots, \alpha_{s}, \beta (i = 1, 2, \cdots, s)$ 线性相关，则存在不全为零的数 $k_{1}, k_{2}, \cdots, k_{i-1}, k_{i+1}, \cdots, k_{s}, k$ 使得
由题设 $\beta=l_{1}\alpha_{1}+l_{2}\alpha_{2}+\cdots+l_{i}\alpha_{i}+\cdots+l_{s}\alpha_{s}$ ，其中 $l_{i}\neq0\quad(i=1,2,\cdots,s)$ ，代入①式可得

$$
\left(k _ {1} + k l _ {1}\right) \alpha_ {1} + \left(k _ {2} + k l _ {2}\right) \alpha_ {2} + \dots + \left(k _ {i - 1} + k l _ {i - 1}\right) \alpha_ {i - 1} + k l _ {i} \alpha_ {i} + \left(k _ {i + 1} + k l _ {i + 1}\right) \alpha_ {i + 1} + \dots + \left(k _ {s} + k l _ {s}\right) \alpha_ {s} = 0.
$$
因为 $\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\cdots,\alpha_{s}$ 线性无关，所以 $kl_{i}=0$ ，但 $l_{i}\neq0$ ，故k=0。代入①式可得

$$
k _ {1} = k _ {2} = \dots = k _ {i - 1} = k _ {i + 1} = \dots = k _ {s} = 0 (\because \alpha_ {1}, \dots , \alpha_ {s} \text {线性无关}).
$$
矛盾. 故任意 $s$ 个向量线性无关.

solution.final_answer: 任意 $s$ 个向量线性无关.
